title: Tio on jazz, reading music, Bechet's hearing and tune ownership
summary: Tio explains that non-readers faked jazz by ear, says he prefers opera to modern jazz, describes Bechet learning from Lorenzo and others, and complains about a composer waiting seven years to publish.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
